bin/runvx RUNPATH lists build-machine directories; CI paths (/__w/...) in binaries and error strings
libvxu and libvx_rpp re-export hundreds of libopenvx symbols and carry duplicate 11 MB GPU kernels
Leaked C++ standard-library symbols in vision libraries and Python modules
Bundled parsers built without stack-protector and FORTIFY
Bundled .so files are mode 0644 and vision objects have no GNU build IDs
Stray *-asan license folders, no pkg-config files, stale protobuf-lite packaging rule
Findrocal requires <rocal/rocal_api.h> rather than the documented "rocal_api.h"
Public headers that are not self-contained (Khronos VX headers, rocal_api_*, internal rocCV headers; vx_ext_amd.h not valid C)

MIVisionX low items (vx_rpp ColorJitter/Glitch/ColorToGreyscale gaps, RGBA NO_RESOURCES, GPU 9x7 convolution, silent CPU fallback, GPU Box3x3 off by one, threshold attribute, read-gdf-sample.gdf, ctest race)
GDFs upstream keeps in cpu/hidden because they fail (incl. the GPU odd-size Convolve cases)
Vision nodes that reject 5x3 and 10x10 images (runVisionTests' small sizes hit validation branches)
openvx-mark reports no timing for MinMaxLoc on GPU
rocAL low items (rocalNop uninitialized memory, color_jitter without GPU path, WebDataset cases registered while disabled, CHECK_LMDB_RETURN_STATUS double evaluation)
rocAL harness gaps (image comparator always exits 0, TF tests print "Install tensorflow" and exit 0, audio test always exits 0)
rocAL golden drift - Hue/Saturation off by 1 LSB; WarpPerspective, Remap and ColorTemp differ on a few border pixels
rocAL crashes instead of reporting errors (grey raw TFRecord, BlendRandom numpy on host, the crash probes)
rocCV WarpAffine NEAREST differs between GPU and CPU (FMA rounding); GammaContrast loses precision on U32; Threshold header documents the wrong layout
rocCV accepts negative padding, singular warp matrices and a NaN rotation angle; copy_to needs a GPU even for CPU tensors
rocCV has no GPU-free CPU path - without a GPU the customer-style CPU flip fails at hipStreamCreate (copy_to too, L-roccv-validation)
rocCV samples - broken -h option, normalize ignores bad options, SIGABRT on bad input
rocCV Gaussian and AverageBlur about 3x slower than comparable operators; Rotate 2.3x slower than WarpAffine
rocCV Python tests check tensor metadata only, and 6 of 25 files are not registered in the installed ctest
Checks that need ROCm torch, tensorflow or jax run only in the extended image
rocPyDecode samples that need hip-python, mpi4py or PyAV (not in the media image)
